review.nextAction: Specify whether all marinade is cooked and consumed; weigh sugar and oil or cite food-specific spoon conversion. Keep R2 corrections as isolated input proposals.

review.preparation: 12 buns, 4 servings. Dough ferments 45+15 minutes then steams 12–15 minutes. Chinese cabbage is squeezed before filling; recipe mass basis before/after squeezing is not stated.
review.compositionMatch: R2 correctly replaces potato starch Fineli 162 with cornstarch Fineli 27. AFCD F009606 live dry-yeast record is available: 6.3 g available carbohydrate, 36.4 g protein, 5 g fat and 26.9 g fibre per100g.
review.amountReview: Soy 2 ×18=36g, corn 1×7=7g, spring onion30g. Yeast7g was omitted in R2 with a nonzero bound; its input contribution is0.11025g carbohydrate,0.637g protein,0.0875g fat,0.47075g fibre per serving. Ginger6g/rkl remains unsupported. Later USDA SR Legacy original-bulk lookup verifies sesame oil FDC171016 teaspoon4.5g; this resolves that specific gap without resolving the whole recipe.
review.retention: Yeast fermentation consumes carbohydrate; squeezed cabbage loses water and soluble nutrients. All-ingredient retention is not a demonstrated final-product model. Neither loss is assigned a fabricated factor.
review.strictComparison: The R2 80.38 g figure is an input subtotal with yeast omitted. Adding known yeast alone would make the input scenario 80.49 g/serving, not validate final cooked carbohydrate.
review.nextAction: Approve corn identity/soy quantities separately; rebuild full ingredient rows including yeast and define cabbage/fermentation basis before a public nutrition update.
review.followupEvidence: After batch1 checkpoint, USDA original bulk was read during batch2/3; sesame oil teaspoon source added, decision remains PARTIAL_ONLY.
